name: a create on a reference whose earlier invoice was paid but not yet scanned answers already paid and mints nothing
note: Exercise the real repository and request handler. Commit 7f..7f for order-golden-settled with a checkout expiring at 1030 (not reusable at clock 1000, so the create would mint a replacement), do NOT settle it, then preclaim the gate so the request's own gated scan is skipped. The wallet's history reports 7f..7f settled at 950 and its make_invoice fails the test if called. Before minting, the handler checks the reference's pending attempts against the wallet, records the settlement, and refuses. Without that check a paid order could be handed a new invoice or a swap deposit address.
